inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Because your Samsung RB34 series appliance is typically covered by a manufacturer warranty' - the customer never said anything about warranty and does not know its status; the appliance is ~6 years old

rationale: The assistant correctly read 'freezer cold, fridge warm, scraping/ticking' as an iced evaporator from a defrost-system fault, proposed a safe 24h manual defrost as a test, and escalated to a professional when the fault returned after five days, matching the ground truth. It was let down by a dropped turn ('AI service unavailable'), a near-verbatim repetition of the same diagnostic paragraph across three messages, a weak drain-hole detour the customer could not answer, and an unsupported assertion that the appliance is 'typically covered by a manufacturer warranty', which could mislead the homeowner into expecting a free Samsung repair. No unsafe instructions and no part was actually recommended for purchase; the heater/thermostat were named only as likely candidates for an engineer to confirm.
